locality: On the W slopes of Cerro Peña Nevada, along the road leading NE from San Antonio Peña Nevada, ca 3-4 km NE of village of Las Palmas.
name: Lobelia gypsophila T.J.Ayers
habitat: Gypsum hillside adjacent to road.  Pinus scattered on gypsum and abundant off of gypsum.  Agave common and arborescent Dasylirion also present.  Site appears to have burned in the last few years, but not a serious fire.  Conditions reasonable.

recordedBy: Michael J. Moore|Hilda Flores Olvera|Helga Ochoterena Booth|Norm Douglas
locality: Along gravel road leading NE of road  from La Escondida to Aramberri.
name: Lobelia gypsophila T.J.Ayers
habitat: Gypsum hillside and adjacent flat surrounded by limestone derived soils. Limestone soils have a noticeably different flora, although there is some overlap floristically between the two substrates. Gypsum Substrates contain a number of gypsum endemics. Selaginella gypsophila is common. Conditions good.
occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”.
